page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by KVM virtualization. The host platform features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz, supplying 16 dedicated virtual CPU cores. Alongside compute processing, the configuration provides 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a generous allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by an integrated NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. The server includes no local NVMe or SSD storage drives, requiring administrators to rely on remote block storage solutions. Network connectivity operates with a baseline throughput of 12 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are attached by default.

In terms of resource density, the combination of a high-capacity 48 GB accelerator and 128.0 GB system memory positions the instance favorably for memory-heavy AI processes relative to standard CPU-only configurations. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of bundled ephemeral disk storage and modest 12 Gbps network bandwidth, which requires external storage planning for high-throughput pipeline inputs.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia.4xlarge is designed primarily for workloads requiring specialized GPU compute and substantial VRAM, including large language model inference, AI fine-tuning, computer vision pipelines, molecular dynamics, and graphical rendering tasks.
